transcribed_question:
A. Side the organ
B. Identify the structure tied
C. What structure is related to the probed area?

marker.description: White thread or tie ligating a structure at the pulmonary hilum.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the tie.
main_explanation: The tie is placed on the pulmonary ligament, a fold of visceral pleura that reflects onto the mediastinal pleura, allowing the lung to descend during deep inspiration.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located in the posterior mediastinum and is related to the area probed?
supporting_question.explanation: The azygos vein arches over the right main bronchus to drain into the SVC and is a key structure of the posterior mediastinum, often probed in this region.
